author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam dusts off his mini table saw for a tune-up and upgrade in preparation for an upcoming architectural model build! These kinds of compact woodworking table saws are perfect for miniatures, and Adam's model just needs a sled for perfect small parts cuts. 

Modelmaking table saw: https://amzn.to/3NtmFWX

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
